title: Interictal contact topography shows static cross-state correspondence and order information without a GRU-specific static-field increment

scientific_panels.B: formal heldout full-vs-rank-shuffle gain alongside matched order-perturbation sensitivity, 34 patients
scientific_panels.C: pre-specified positive signed early-ictal readout, 16 patients
scientific_panels.D: orientation-free morphology under all-contact, within-shaft, and smooth-field nulls; absolute correlation permits similar or reversed contact ordering
scientific_panels.E: full-GRU static increment over target-free and history controls
scientific_panels.F: one-confound-at-a-time partial-rank morphology versus residual permutation null; not multivariable causal adjustment

claim_boundary: True event order improves heldout NLL over a separately trained rank-shuffle GRU, but the full-history GRU does not outperform the strongest nonrecurrent prefix comparator; interictal participation and early-ictal energy show orientation-free contact-topography correspondence that is also present in nonrecurrent fields; absolute correlation does not establish positive replay, a physical axis or dynamic seizure propagation.
